pr_title: Don't generate bounding box touching tiles in GeoTileGridAggregatorTests
pr_body:
in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/100826 we added a more aggresive way to handle geotile boundaries which has made this test fail whenever we gerate a bounding box that contains a share boundary with a tile. Therefore this PR make sure we generate bounding boxes that do not share boundaries with geotiles.

fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/101077
pr_comments: This PR should also unmute the tests mutred in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/101109#issuecomment-1770369207
